headline: Higher volumes and realizations drive growth

The Essentials segment contributed 77% to revenue and grew 61% YoY, with EBITDAM expanding 800bps YoY, supported by strong double-digit volume growth and improved spreads.
The Specialty Chemicals segment reported 36% YoY revenue growth, while EBITDAM expanded to 220bps YoY but declined 280bps QoQ due to delayed cost pass-through under long-term customer contracts.
Management indicated that higher input costs could not be immediately passed on to contract customers.
